# tidepic

> tidepic is a set of rules for showing numbers as scenery instead of charts. A sender publishes a small JSON feed. A companion (a web page) reads the feed and turns it into a scene: flowers that open, a train that climbs, windows that light up. A scene is for reading the mood of a number, not its exact value.

If you are asked to connect some data to a tidepic scene, you are being asked to write a feed. If you are asked to make a new scene, you are being asked to make a companion. There is a guide for each.

## Read first

- [Guide for writing a feed](https://tidepic.com/GUIDE.md): the shape of a feed, which fields to use for which kind of number, examples, common mistakes
- [안내: 피드 쓰는 법](https://tidepic.com/GUIDE.ko.md): the same guide in Korean
- [Guide for making a companion](https://tidepic.com/COMPANION.md): deciding what the numbers become, the two ways to make one (a case table, or drawing code), the files, images, and how to check it
- [안내: 컴패니언 만드는 법](https://tidepic.com/COMPANION.ko.md): the same guide in Korean

## Scenes to connect to

- [Tidepark gallery](https://tidepark.com/gallery): companions you can connect a feed to. Each scene's page lets you pick a skin and settings and shows the feed JSON with them in `view`, ready to copy
- [Tidepark llms.txt](https://tidepark.com/llms.txt): each scene's address, skin names, options, still picture and sample feed
- [tidetop](https://github.com/tidepark/tidetop): a terminal program that draws a scene from a feed with `tidetop --data <feed address> --scene <name>` (grove, stars, library, campfire, tide, windows). Without `--data` it shows the computer's spare CPU or memory. Install with `npx tidetop`, Homebrew or a release binary

## Reference

- [The spec](https://tidepic.com/SPEC.md): the full rules. The current version is at the top
- [규칙](https://tidepic.com/SPEC.ko.md): the spec in Korean
- [Feed checker](https://tidepic.com/check.html): paste a feed and see what a companion will draw from it
- [Companion maker](https://tidepic.com/make.html): put in a few pictures or one GIF, see them change with a number, and download a companion made with a case table
- [Runtime source](https://github.com/tidepark/tidepic/tree/main/runtime): validation and computation in JavaScript (`validateFeed`, `computeFeed`, `checkFeed`)

## Examples

- [Case table example](https://tidepic.com/examples/table/?v=50&to=100&num=1): a companion made from a table and images, with no drawing code
- [Its files](https://github.com/tidepark/tidepic/tree/main/examples/table): `scenes.json` and the images, as a starting point for a companion of your own
- [Drawing code example](https://tidepic.com/examples/code/?v=60&to=100): a companion drawn with code (`draw.js`), with no pictures
- [Its files](https://github.com/tidepark/tidepic/tree/main/examples/code): `draw.js` and the settings, as a starting point for a companion drawn with code
